evaluation_config.seed: first 8 SHA256 bytes big-endian of UTF-8 split:case_id:decimal_seed

artifact_scope: Preliminary core-evaluation wheel; not the final release artifact or UI acceptance
limitations: Authored synthetic cases, not independently sampled customer documents.
Random seeds repeat the same cases and do not enlarge the independent-input denominator.
Default lambda1 held-out aggregate metrics match fixed; no default held-out advantage is established.
Lambda0 and4 are preregistered sensitivities, not posthoc replacements for the default.
Field cost is declared effort, separate from actual elapsed time and money.
Resolution is conditional on the finite supplied alternatives.
After publication, corpus replays are regression evaluations, not fresh held-out evidence.
